articles.summary: Third Quarter 2026 Highlights (All results reflect comparisons to prior-year period, unless otherwise noted) Sales of $350.8 million, up 22.4% AST sales up 25.8%; Sealing Technologies sales up 20.5% Net income of $40.3 million versus $21.6 million Adjusted EBITDA* of $91.3 million versus $69.3 million GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.88 versus $1.01 Adjusted diluted earnings per share* of $2.66 versus $1.99 Raising full-year 2026 guidance: Revenue expected to be in the range of $1.33 billion to $1.34 billion, adjusted EBITDA* in the range of $340 million to $345 million and adjusted diluted earnings per share* in the range of $9.70 to $9.95 Enpro Inc. (NYSE: NPO) today announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “Our strong third quarter performance reflects our disciplined execution and success of Enpro 3.0 as we continue to accelerate profitable growth across the organization," said Eric Vaillancourt, President and Chief Executive Officer.
articles.title: Enpro Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results; Raises Full-Year Guidance
